shorts_extract.hook: Why your hand can slap the snooze bar in two seconds while your brain pours coffee onto the counter ten minutes later.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Balkin (2002 PET), Wertz (2006 JAMA 26-hour benchmark), and Vallat (2019 EEG-fMRI) scanning the waking human brain.
shorts_extract.twist: Your brainstem wakes instantly, yet your prefrontal cortex trails 25 minutes behind—performing worse than 26 hours without sleep.
